mapper.insert: INSERT INTO property ( user_id, description, property_type, transaction_type, price, deposit, monthly_rent, maintenance_fee, region_id, detail_address, area_m2, room_count, bathroom_count, floor, move_in_date, source_type, status ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{description}, #{propertyType}, #{transactionType}, #{price}, #{deposit}, #{monthlyRent}, #{maintenanceFee}, #{regionId}, #{detailAddress}, #{areaM2}, #{roomCount}, #{bathroomCount}, #{floor}, #{moveInDate}, #{sourceType}, #{status} )

INSERT INTO property_image (property_id, image_url, is_thumbnail, sort_order) VALUES
(#{img.propertyId}, #{img.imageUrl}, #{img.isThumbnail}, #{img.sortOrder})

INSERT INTO property_option (property_id, option_id, option_value) VALUES
(#{propertyId}, #{optId}, NULL)
mapper.select: SELECT property_id AS propertyId, user_id AS userId, status AS status, deleted_at AS deletedAt, created_at AS createdAt FROM property WHERE property_id = #{propertyId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM region WHERE region_id = #{regionId}

SELECT p.property_id ,p.user_id ,p.description ,p.property_type ,p.transaction_type ,p.price ,p.deposit ,p.monthly_rent ,p.maintenance_fee ,p.detail_address ,p.area_m2 ,p.room_count ,p.bathroom_count ,p.floor ,p.move_in_date ,p.source_type ,p.status ,CASE WHEN u.`role` = 'AGENT' THEN a.office_name ELSE u.nick END AS property_user_nick ,CASE WHEN u.`role` = 'AGENT' THEN a.agent_image_url ELSE '' END AS agent_image_url ,u.role AS property_user_role ,r.region_id ,r.province ,r.city ,r.district FROM property p LEFT JOIN region r ON p.region_id = r.region_id LEFT JOIN user u ON u.user_id = p.user_id LEFT JOIN agent a ON u.user_id = a.user_id WHERE p.property_id = #{propertyId} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT image_id AS imageId, image_url AS imageUrl, is_thumbnail AS isThumbnail, sort_order AS sortOrder FROM property_image WHERE property_id = #{propertyId} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY sort_order
SELECT po.option_id AS optionId, o.option_name AS optionName, po.option_value AS optionValue FROM property_option po JOIN `option` o ON po.option_id = o.option_id WHERE po.property_id = #{propertyId}
mapper.update:
UPDATE property
description = #{description}, property_type = #{propertyType}, transaction_type = #{transactionType}, price = #{price}, deposit = #{deposit}, monthly_rent = #{monthlyRent}, maintenance_fee = #{maintenanceFee}, region_id = #{regionId}, detail_address = #{detailAddress}, area_m2 = #{areaM2}, room_count = #{roomCount}, bathroom_count = #{bathroomCount}, floor = #{floor}, move_in_date = #{moveInDate},
WHERE property_id = #{propertyId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE property SET updated_at = NOW(), deleted_at = NOW() WHERE property_id = #{propertyId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE property_image SET updated_at = NOW(), deleted_at = NOW() WHERE property_id = #{propertyId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
